'''Ranadaast''' was the former [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. It was named after [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]] but came to be known as the '''City of Ashes''' or '''Royal City''' by offworld [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. Once a beautiful city, it grew filthy with the industrialization on Duro. Underneath the city were the [[Burial/Legends|tombs]] of many past [[King/Legends|monarchs]]. The Duros [[Dustini Spa Ronii]] hired some adventures to go down to the city to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on individuals he believed were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] artifacts offworld. It also came to be inhabited by giant [[fefze beetle]]s.
